cd /app && python3 - << 'EOF'
import json, subprocess, sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/app/tmp'); import valtest
base=json.dumps(valtest.BASE).encode()

def run(data):
    p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'/app/submission/main.py'],input=data,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    return p.returncode, p.stdout

# 16 MiB boundary
MIB=16*1024*1024
pad = b' ' * (MIB - len(base) - 1)
rc,out = run(base + pad)
print("exactly 16MiB-1 padding: ", "ok" if b'packets' in out else ("ERR "+out[:80].decode()), "len", len(base)+len(pad))
pad2 = b' ' * (MIB - len(base) + 1)
rc,out = run(base + pad2)
print("16MiB+1 padding: ", "rejected" if out.strip()==b'{"error":"invalid-input"}' else "NOT REJECTED "+out[:80].decode())
# huge array input > 16MiB
big = json.dumps({"version":1,"config":valtest.BASE["config"],"model":valtest.BASE["model"],
                  "connections":[{"id":"c%d"%i,"slot":0,"label":0,"split":"dev"} for i in range(2048)],
                  "packets":[{"time":i,"connection":"c%d"%(i%2048),"length":i%60000,"draw":i%60000} for i in range(20000)]}).encode()
print("big valid doc size:", len(big))
rc,out=run(big)
print("big doc:", "ok" if b'packets' in out else "ERR", "stdout bytes:", len(out), "elapsed check later")
EOF
